rationale:
- Authentication: Correct. The agent verified the user via full name + zip and matched to a single account.
- Pre-change confirmation: Insufficient. The agent asked the user to pick variants and, upon receiving the selections, executed an exchange without explicitly restating the exact changes and obtaining an explicit “Proceed to exchange?” confirmation as required by policy.
- Tool support and correctness: The exchange tool call response did not clearly confirm a successful exchange, yet the agent stated it was processed—an unsupported claim. The agent also asserted that exchanges “cannot be changed or cancelled” and that the system allows only one action per delivered item, which were not supported by any tool outputs or stated policy, indicating fabrication.
- Handling change requests: When the user asked to only exchange the desk lamp (and later to return the water bottle), the agent refused without checking eligibility or offering escalation to a human as required when an action may fall outside tool capability.
- Overall: Multiple policy violations—missing explicit pre-write confirmation, unsupported statements about system limitations and exchange status, and failure to correctly handle follow-up changes—mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
